generation_workflow: Abaqus cae noGUI opened task18_punch_plate_init.cae, completed IndentationStep/contact/BC/output/job in that model, submitted Task18_PunchPlate, waited for JOB_STATUS_COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY, and extracted metrics from the final ODB frame.
metrics_rewrite_workflow: Abaqus 2025 odbAccess reopened the verified Task18_PunchPlate.odb, independently recomputed the same four final-frame metrics, and wrote the JSON payload in binary mode with explicit LF bytes.

model.material: EngineeringPolymer: E=2100 MPa, nu=0.35, linear elastic demonstration

verification.topology_chain: Exact mesh signatures match init to GT and GT to ODB for Plate-1; exact CAE punch geometry/placement/reference point and ODB reference-point node/location link the analytical rigid punch.
verification.semantic_checks: PlateSection binds EngineeringPolymer; the supplied and completed punch edge signatures match; generated PUNCH_CONTACT is a radius-5 semicircle represented by START plus two CIRCL segments with exact endpoints and common center; Initial finite-sliding hard-frictionless contact, exact boundary DOFs and extraction-set members, one CPU, and opposite raw reaction signs are verified.
verification.negative_tests: Config-only, init-as-candidate, missing ODB, wrong displacement, NO SEPARATION, and a real Abaqus V-shaped two-LINE punch candidate all returned False\n.
